question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Tax Relief for Fraud Victims Act (H R 9500)
plain_language: This bill widens the tax deduction for theft and fraud losses, including losses that are not from a declared disaster, and it eases related refund and retirement-plan rules. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.
